{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv')

# Clean revenue: remove commas, convert to float
# First, verify that all revenue values are valid numeric strings with commas
print("Revenue values with commas:", df['revenue'].str.contains(r',', regex=True).sum())

# Apply cleaning: remove commas and convert to float
df['revenue_clean'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Confirm no QA orders
print("Number of QA orders (revenue == 999999.99):", (df['revenue_clean'] == 999999.99).sum())

# Check status: only completed orders contribute to revenue
# Filter out refunded orders
df_completed = df[df['status'] == 'completed']

# Now, group by channel and sum revenue
revenue_by_channel = df_completed.groupby('channel')['revenue_clean'].sum()
print("Revenue by channel (completed only):", revenue_by_channel)

# Find the channel with the most revenue
max_channel = revenue_by_channel.idxmax()
max_revenue = revenue_by_channel.max()

print(f"Channel with most revenue: {max_channel} with {max_revenue:,.2f}")"}
